cardFixesApplied.to: Battista je elektrický dvoumístný vůz ručně vyráběný v italském Cambianu do roku 2025. Vedle kupé vznikl také jediný otevřený exemplář Targamerica. Oznámený výrobní limit není údaj o skutečně dokončeném počtu.

openQuestions: Partial breadth pass:one Battista card/one record and two raw entities inventoried.

Open body coverage refers solely to delivered2024 one-offTargamerica; it does not claim a regular series convertible.
Germany legal/commercial country metadata versus operational headquarters and manufacture inCambianoItaly needs explicit corporate/legal country policy; no silent Germany→Italy rewrite.
B95 scheduled2025 manufacture must not be marked current based on2023 announcement alone.2026 project/organizational reports require primary corroboration.
PininfarinaSpA is distinct from AutomobiliPininfarina; design-house financial statements do not establish this marque status.
PURA Vision is explicitly a design concept and should not become a production-model card.
Production limit150 is not verified actual total; no built-unit number populated.
Special-edition Battistas remain within Battista family; technical rows/photos not comprehensively reverified.
